meta.title: Route B (engine B), PART C: composite kernels C^(2)_{P_b}, C^(2)_Delta, D_1 and P_1 on the families, Conjecture P7
meta.unit: u = hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2); kernel coefficients in units hbar/(16 pi^2) times C_w = (1 (x) ad_{Y_w1}...ad_{Y_wr})(-,-)^{-1}; planar adjacent pair: (-1)^r c/2 units u
meta.Z_definition: Z_x(X_a,X_b;eps) = Q-image part = (hbar/2) d_{K_x}(chain trees with one edge K_eps - K_0) (manuscript Delta_0 = -d_{K_0}: the bracket vertex {I,M}_eps - {I,M} is minus the tree with edge K_eps - K_0; this equals "minus (hbar/2) d_{K_x} of the chains with the special edge" of Def def:cc-sp read with the special edge as the bracket vertex); C^(2)_x = coefficient of eps^0
meta.kernel_form: K_{P_b} = (d_b (x) 1 - 1 (x) d_b) X = 2 i (b.k) MX(k) e^{-2 eps k^2}/k^4; K_Delta = (v.(x)1 - 1(x)v.)X, position part 2 K_{P_b}, translation-invariant part: Euler operator -2(4 + k.d_k) on the line plus 2(y - x_O).(2 i k) with y the column end (option 3) or both ends (option 2)
meta.families_kinematics: collinear on-shell outputs p_j = t_j nbar, nbar = (1/2,-i/2,0,0), derivatives n.d, n = (1,i,0,0) (engine components; Weinberg-Srednicki two-component: n_m sigma^m proportional to a rank-one matrix, D_n = n_m D_m); scalars Z = A_4 + i A_5 (A_{ij} component of R-weight (1,0,0)); psi = lambda_+ letter of R-weight (1/2,1/2,-1/2) and Lorentz weight (1/2,1/2) (on shell for p ~ nbar); gluon eps = e_2 - i e_3, F11 = (1/2) c^{mn} F_{mn}, c = n ^ e', e' = e_2 + i e_3 (field strength of the chirality of psi psi)

F0_so6_pair_AperpAperp_W0.description: general SO(6) letters a, b and outputs Y0, Y1 (all symbolic), per colour word; i(b.pj) = d_b on output j
F0_so6_pair_AperpAperp_W0.planar_density: identity only: C2_Delta^0 = -(4/3) u X_a X_b, C2_Pb = -(1/6) u (d_b X_a X_b + X_a d_b X_b) per adjacent pair (no exchange, no trace term)
F0_so6_pair_AperpAperp_W0.two_component: (A_ij, A_kl) adjacent: C2_Delta^0 = -(4/3) u A_ij A_kl, C2_Pb = -(1/6) u b_m d_m (A_ij A_kl)

D1_P1_free_directions.statement: on every family computed (two-field shell, cohomology): sum C2_{P_b} = -(1/3) u d_b and sum C2^0_Delta = -(2/3) u N, so
D1_P1_free_directions.D1_position_part: (D_1)^b = 2 sum C2_{P_b} - 2u sum_a theta_{diamond(a)} d_b X_a = -2u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) d_b X_a
D1_P1_free_directions.D1_translation_invariant: D_1^0 = 4 lc^natural + sum_a u(c_phi - 2 theta_{diamond(a)} w_a) X_a - (2/3) u N = 4 lc^natural - 2u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) w_a X_a (c_A = 2/3, c_lambda = 1/3, sum_a (c_phi + (2/3) w_a) = (2/3) N); kappa_V, kappa_lambda terms s-exact, zero on the shell
D1_P1_free_directions.Xi_Delta: -u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) v.|_{letter a}; equal theta: -(1/3 + theta) u {S^(1)(Delta),-}
D1_P1_free_directions.arity_two: position part exact (Thm thm:cc-arity2) and d_b O not exact on these families => theta_perp = theta_lambda = theta_V = -1/3 on every family with letters of that sector (F1: theta_perp; F2 fermion: theta_lambda; F3 gluon: theta_V; mixed families: all), D_1 = 4 lc^natural
D1_P1_free_directions.P1: P_1 = sum C2_{P_b} - u sum_a theta^P_{diamond(a)} d_b X_a = -u sum_a (1/3 + theta^P_{diamond(a)}) d_b X_a (+ kappa^P terms, s-exact); translation-covariant scheme theta^P = theta = -1/3: P_1 = 0 (Cor cor:cc-theta (iii)); equal theta^P: P_1 = u(theta - theta^P) d_b at theta = -1/3
D1_P1_free_directions.two_component: D_1 = -8 u E_H = (g^2 N/(4 pi^2)) E_H on eigenstates; P_1 = -(1/3 + theta^P) u b_m d_m, -(1/3) u = g^2 N/(96 pi^2)
